title: Security docs gap analysis for AWS/GCP Marketplace submissions (required artifacts vs existing docs)
creator: Chris Osei
description:
## Context
Marketplace reviewers (AWS + GCP) and enterprise buyers are asking for a consistent “security packet” that is:
- accurate (no over-claims)
- easy to navigate
- scoped to Redwood’s hosted + dedicated + private deployment modes
- usable both for marketplace review and for customer security questionnaires

This ticket documents the gap analysis between typical marketplace security requirements and what we currently have in Confluence / docs site, and outputs a concrete checklist with owners (Security/GRC + Docs) and target publish locations.

## Inputs reviewed
- Existing “Marketplace security documentation pack” index (Confluence)
- Data handling/retention draft (Confluence)
- Audit logs for marketplace customers (Confluence)
- Draft marketplace security questionnaire responses (Drive)
- Partner call notes: AWS marketplace listing review + GCP onboarding/billing review (Fireflies)
- Docs IA plan for marketplace onboarding (Confluence)

## Definition of done
1) Identify required/expected artifacts for AWS + GCP marketplace security review and for enterprise procurement.
2) Mark each artifact as: Exists / Needs update / Missing.
3) For each gap: assign an owner, propose a publish location (public docs vs gated vs on-request), and specify what wording constraints apply.
4) Output a checklist that can be tracked to completion and referenced by PM-1845/PM-1846 submission checklists.

---

## Required artifacts inventory (AWS/GCP marketplace + enterprise procurement)
Note: Marketplace teams often accept “equivalent” artifacts if they are well-structured, but they will reject vague statements or marketing language that implies certifications we do not hold.

### 1) Security overview + shared responsibility (customer-facing)
- Expectation: a short overview describing product boundaries, deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private), and a shared responsibility model.
- Current state: PARTIAL. We have internal notes but not a marketplace-friendly, customer-facing summary with clear boundaries.
- Gap: Missing clear “what we do vs what customer does” split per deployment mode.
- Owner: Naomi Feldman (Security) + Elliot Price (Docs)
- Publish: Public docs (marketplace-linked), with a “contact us for evidence” section.

### 2) Data flow diagrams (high-level) + system architecture narrative
- Expectation: diagram(s) showing request path, data stores, logs, key services, and where encryption applies.
- Current state: MISSING for marketplace packet. We have internal architecture diagrams but not approved for external distribution.
- Gap: Need simplified DFD that avoids sensitive infrastructure details.
- Owner: Marcus Lin (Security Eng) + Simran Kaur (Reference architecture) + Alicia Perez (visuals)
- Publish: Gated (sales/security review) OR public “high-level” version + gated detailed version.

### 3) Data handling: prompts/inputs/outputs, retention, deletion, and residency
- Expectation: explicit statements on what customer data is processed/stored, default retention, configurable retention, deletion SLAs, and available regions/residency constraints.
- Current state: PARTIAL. Draft exists (marketplace-data-handling-and-retention) but needs tightening/consistency.
- Gaps:
  - Clarify defaults separately for: request payloads, generated outputs, logs/metrics, traces.
  - Clarify how Dedicated changes isolation vs Hosted (and what remains shared).
  - Clarify Private (VPC/on-prem) data-plane vs control-plane data.
  - Add “entitlement + billing data” handling (marketplace-specific).
- Owner: Olga Petrov (GRC) + Naomi Feldman (Security) + Kira Thompson (Docs)
- Publish: Public docs (marketplace-linked).

### 4) Encryption (in transit / at rest) + key management (KMS/HSM options)
- Expectation: TLS details at a high level; storage encryption; KMS integrations; customer-managed keys story for Private/VPC.
- Current state: NEEDS UPDATE. We mention encryption but not in a structured, reviewer-friendly format.
- Gaps:
  - Add a single section with: “in transit”, “at rest”, “keys”, “rotation”, “customer options by deployment mode”.
  - Confirm wording around “customer-managed keys” to match actual product capabilities (avoid implying CMK for Hosted if not generally available).
- Owner: Marcus Lin (Security Eng) + Colin O'Donnell (Private SME) + Elliot Price (Docs)
- Publish: Public docs with careful wording + on-request addendum for regulated customers.

### 5) Audit logging (what is logged, retention, export/SIEM)
- Expectation: specific event categories (auth, admin actions, API key creation, org changes, model/policy changes), retention, and export mechanism.
- Current state: EXISTS (audit-logs-for-marketplace-customers) but needs marketplace framing.
- Gaps:
  - Add “minimum set” of events that apply across Hosted/Dedicated/Private.
  - Clarify whether audit logs are included by default vs add-on/enterprise.
  - Add “how to request” and “format” notes (e.g., webhook/S3/SIEM integration) without over-committing.
- Owner: Naomi Feldman + Kira Thompson
- Publish: Public docs (marketplace-linked).

### 6) Access control: RBAC, SSO/SAML, least privilege, admin controls
- Expectation: describe console/org RBAC, SSO availability, API key scoping/rotation best practices.
- Current state: PARTIAL across internal docs; not collected in one place.
- Gap: Missing consolidated customer-facing access control overview.
- Owner: Naomi Feldman + Alex Martinez (DevEx)
- Publish: Public docs; include “enterprise features may require contract” line.

### 7) Vulnerability management + patching + secure SDLC
- Expectation: high-level vuln management process, scanning, patch timelines, disclosure program.
- Current state: MISSING / too internal.
- Gap: Need a customer-facing statement that is truthful and non-sensitive.
- Owner: Olga Petrov + Marcus Lin
- Publish: Gated or “public summary” with on-request detail.

### 8) Incident response + breach notification
- Expectation: statement on monitoring, incident handling, customer notification timelines (often “per contract” or “without undue delay”).
- Current state: PARTIAL (internal IR runbooks; not customer-facing).
- Gap: Need marketplace-appropriate incident response summary.
- Owner: Olga Petrov + Naomi Feldman
- Publish: Gated (usually acceptable for marketplace) or public short summary.

### 9) Compliance posture + evidence access path (SOC 2 / ISO)
- Expectation: clear posture statement (“SOC 2 Type II”, “ISO 27001”, etc.) and how evidence can be requested (portal, NDA).
- Current state: PARTIAL. We have evidence links but need an approved “how to consume evidence” flow.
- Gaps:
  - Create an evidence index that does not leak sensitive attachments publicly.
  - Add explicit scoping statement (which products/environments are covered).
- Owner: Olga Petrov (GRC) + Daniel Carter (evidence) + Elliot Price (Docs)
- Publish: Public posture statement + gated evidence index.

### 10) Subprocessors / third-party services
- Expectation: list of subprocessors relevant to data processing and links to DPA/terms.
- Current state: UNKNOWN/fragmented.
- Gap: Need an externally shareable subprocessor list or policy link.
- Owner: Olga Petrov + Sofia Mendes (counsel) + Elliot Price
- Publish: Public (standard), with change notification mechanism.

### 11) Data deletion + account termination workflow
- Expectation: how to request deletion, what is deleted, timelines, exceptions (billing/finance/legal).
- Current state: MISSING.
- Gap: Add a marketplace-friendly section aligned to retention policy.
- Owner: Naomi Feldman + Kira Thompson
- Publish: Public docs.

### 12) Marketplace-specific: metering/entitlement data + procurement support boundaries
- Expectation: what data is exchanged with AWS/GCP marketplace for subscription/entitlement/metering; support SLAs; escalation path.
- Current state: PARTIAL in onboarding docs and internal enablement.
- Gap: Need a short “marketplace integration data” note in security packet + link to onboarding.
- Owner: Chris Osei (PM Ops) + Ben Carter (Growth) + Elliot Price
- Publish: Public docs (in marketplace onboarding section) + reference from security overview.

## Publishing guidance (what goes where)
- Public docs (marketplace-linked):
  - Security overview + shared responsibility
  - Data handling/retention
  - Audit logs overview
  - Access control overview
  - Compliance posture statement (no evidence attachments)
  - Subprocessors list/policy link
- Gated / on-request (via SE/Security):
  - Detailed data flow diagrams (if needed)
  - SOC2 report/evidence artifacts and control mappings
  - Pen test summaries (if available) and vulnerability management details
  - Incident response playbook details

## Notes / constraints
- Avoid statements that imply “no data stored” unless we can prove across all logs/traces. Prefer precise scoping: what is stored, where, and how long.
- Keep Hosted/Dedicated/Private differences explicit. Marketplace buyers are frequently confused about whether Dedicated implies “single-tenant control plane” (it does not by default).
- Any change in retention defaults must be reviewed for consistency across:
  - marketplace listing copy
  - onboarding docs
  - security questionnaire responses

## Related work
- Docs PRs planned/active: marketplace onboarding pages + security overview publication
- Security packet index exists but requires restructure once new pages are ready
- Submission checklists: PM-1845 (AWS) / PM-1846 (GCP)

## Final deliverable from this ticket
A gap checklist (above) with owners, publish locations, and wording constraints; to be converted into follow-up Linear tickets and tracked through marketplace submission.
